DocuMate AI — Intelligent Documentation Generator & Maintainer
Comprehensive Project Specification, Architecture, Requirements, Tech Stack, and Agile Implementation Plan
Generated on: 2026-05-13 16:00:44
1. Project Overview
DocuMate AI is a full-stack AI-powered documentation automation platform that automatically generates, updates, and maintains documentation for software repositories. The platform integrates with GitHub repositories, analyzes codebases using AST parsing, detects stale documen

tation, and regenerates relevant documentation using LLMs.
The system aims to solve documentation drift — a common problem where documentation becomes outdated as code evolves.
2. Problem Statement
Engineering teams spend significant time manually writing and maintaining documentation. As repositories grow, documentation often becomes outdated, reducing developer productivity and increasing onboarding time.
DocuMate AI automates documentation generation and synchronization using AI, semantic sea

rch, GitHub integration, and incremental analysis.
3. Objectives
Automatically generate project documentation
Detect stale or outdated documentation
Provide semantic documentation search
Generate API documentation from source code
Create architecture diagrams automatically
Integrate with GitHub pull requests and webhooks
Reduce developer documentation workload
4. Software Requirements Specification (SRS)
4.1 Functional Requirements
Repository integration via GitHub OAuth and GitHub App
Webhook h

andling for push and pull request events
AST-based source code analysis
README generation using LLMs
API documentation generation
Incremental documentation updates
Staleness detection
Semantic documentation search
RAG-powered Q&A
PR review bot for missing documentation
Documentation analytics dashboard
Architecture diagram generation
4.2 Non-Functional Requirements
System should support large repositories and monorepos
Documentation generation should complete within 30 seconds for average reposi

tories
Semantic search response should be below 2 seconds
System should support horizontal worker scaling
Secure storage of OAuth and API tokens
Reliable background processing with retry mechanisms
High maintainability through modular architecture
Version-controlled documentation updates
